messages:
Courtney (CEO): @channel Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10am PT. I’ll share a brief agenda and a few things we’ll ask for input on. Please drop any questions here so we can slot them into the Q&A.
Marcus (VP Product): agenda request: 1) launch callouts for Redwood Optimize beta 2) new data retention policy 3) incident retro highlights 4) AMA with execs. Is 30-40 mins okay?
Anika (Eng Manager): 30 mins is tight but doable if we keep the product demo to 6-8m. I can prep a short demo + 2 slides on perf/cost wins.
Raj (SRE): I’ll take 3-4 mins on the incident summary — root cause, mitigations, follow-ups. Will post a 1-slide TL;DR.
Leah (People Ops): planning to announce the updated parental leave and hybrid work guidance during townhall as well — want that after the exec update.
Courtney (CEO): sound good. Final agenda: 1) Exec update (me) 2) Product demo + launch callouts (Marcus/Anika) 3) Incident summary + learnings (Raj) 4) Policy update (Leah) 5) Q&A / AMA (all). Recording will be posted.
Marcus (VP Product): Callouts to prep: target dev partner list, migration checklist for Dedicated customers, rolling start date for Optimize beta. If folks have launch blockers, flag them here by EOD.
Anika (Eng Manager): Posting demo notes: keep prompts + perf numbers public (no customer PII). Slide will include 2 graphs: latency distribution pre/post batching and cost per 1k tokens.
Raj (SRE): Incident TL;DR: last week we saw a 45-min degradation caused by autoscaler race on node drain. Mitigation: fixed drain ordering + added a healthcheck gate. Follow-ups: improve runbook + canary scale tests.
Leah (People Ops): For policy update: new data retention defaults are 90 days for untagged logs; customers can opt into longer retention via contract. We’ll provide checklist for teams touching telemetry and auditing.
Anika (Eng Manager): tiny ask — can someone from Security add a short note about telemetry masking? I’ll need a one-liner for the slide.
Courtney (CEO): @security-team please add. Also want to highlight that Dedicated customers with compliance needs will see private deployment options accelerated — details in the follow-up doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands calendar invite sent to @everyone for 2025-05-12 17:00 UTC.
Marcus (VP Product): Please comment with any Qs you want in the AMA thread. Example Qs: impact on latency SLOs, migration support timeline, pricing changes, rollout gating criteria.
Leah (People Ops): Note: we’ll run an anonymous pulse at the end of the week for feedback on the policy changes.
Courtney (CEO): Thanks team. If you can’t attend live, leave Qs here and we’ll read them out. Recording + slides will be posted after.
--- (post all-hands, recording + takeaways) ---
Marcus (VP Product): Recording: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/optimize-beta-launch-2001122334 :thumbsup: Slides: https://redwood.example.com/slides/optimize-launch-2001122334.pdf
Anika (Eng Manager): Demo notes and perf deck attached in slides. Key takeaway: intelligent batching reduced average p99 by ~120ms and cut token cost by ~18% in our internal workloads.
Raj (SRE): Incident summary slide (one-pager) here: https://redwood.example.com/incident/200105-az-autoscaler. Action items: 1) add drain-order check to autoscaler by 5/20 2) schedule canary scaling tests weekly 3) update runbook and test validation.
Leah (People Ops): Policy doc and FAQs: https://redwood.example.com/policy/data-retention-2025. Important: if your team writes telemetry, check for fields that are PII and flag to security.
Courtney (CEO): Takeaways: 1) Optimize beta is live for limited partners — we’ll expand in waves. 2) We’re tightening default retention to reduce risk and improve cost transparency. 3) Ops improvements underway to avoid repeat infra incidents. Thanks for the great questions.
Marcus (VP Product): Post-meeting ask: product/solutions teams — compile a 1-pager for customers impacted by retention default change. Share to #customer-success by EOD Friday.
Anika (Eng Manager): Engineering follow-up: I’ll open a PR for the demo code + perf harness in the repo and tag @devex.
Raj (SRE): Will track the incident follow-ups in the SRE board — link: https://redwood.example.com/sre/board/123
Leah (People Ops): Pulse link (anonymous feedback): https://redwood.example.com/pulse/2001122334 — please fill out even if you were on the call.
Courtney (CEO): Closing note: appreciate the cross-team collaboration on the rollout and on the ops fixes. If you need context or resources to communicate to customers, ping Marcus or Leah.
ops-bot: Posted recording to knowledge base and scheduled auto-transcript.
